name: A Solar System in the Wash
prompt: Float eight enamel planet bowls in a broad dark circular basin. Fine chains draw them along elliptical grooves. At the edge a mechanic lifts one bowl from the water, revealing its little submerged paddlewheel.

name: The Pocket Universe
prompt: Open an immense brass watchcase flat against a green baize lawn. Its lid is a polished night sky, its lower half an exposed orrery. Visitors walk between the moving arms, winding individual planets with silver keys.

name: The Long Year
prompt: Unroll the solar system into one narrow elevated track with planet markers spaced at dramatically unequal intervals. A tiny bright sun crowds the inner markers. Far down the quiet track a lone visitor pushes an indigo outer planet.

name: The Astronomer's Mobile
prompt: Hang differently weighted ceramic worlds from an asymmetric mobile of black rods. Observers move small counterweights to reproduce the planets' current positions. A shallow white floor receives an intricate, changing drawing of thin shadows.

name: The Orange Peel Cosmos
prompt: Spiral a wide orange copper ribbon upward around an empty vertical axis. Each turn supports one enamelled planet and its tiny attendant. A mechanic at the free end peels back a damaged segment to expose a row of drive teeth.
